entities.name: B2JD61 acetyl-CoA synthetase
observations: Exact sequence match (100% identity and coverage) to reviewed UniProt B2JD61 from Paraburkholderia phymatum; annotated as acetyl-CoA synthetase, EC 6.2.1.1.
Pfam matches: ACAS_N (PF16177), AMP-binding (PF00501), and AMP-binding_C (PF13193).

entities.name: Acetate to acetyl-CoA
observations: Annotated reaction: acetate + ATP + CoA = acetyl-CoA + AMP + diphosphate (Rhea RHEA:23176).

entities.name: Acetyl-CoA biosynthesis
observations: Associated biological process: acetyl-CoA biosynthetic process (GO:0006085); acetyl-CoA links anabolic and catabolic metabolism.
